thread:
Maya (Docs): Quick broadcast: Docs and SDK note — we're changing how the SDK surfaces tokenization hints in responses. New behavior goes live tomorrow 07:00 PT.

Jon (Eng-runtime): To clarify: the payload will include `token_hint` only when the model truncation affects the end of output. Previously it was sporadic. This should make client-side resumption logic simpler.

Priya (Support): Customers using streaming resumption flagged fragile logic. Will the old behavior still be present?

Jon (Eng-runtime): Backcompat: we keep the old `token_hint` key for 30 days but the shape is standardized (string of token ids, comma-separated). After 30 days we'll remove legacy formats.

Maya (Docs): Uploaded migration snippet and FAQ: internal link https://intranet.redwood/docs/sdk-token-hint-update. Included examples for JS/Python and a grep command to find usages.

docs-bot: Docs published: https://intranet.redwood/docs/sdk-token-hint-update (internal).

release-bot: Scheduled rollout: canary us-east-1 @ 1729162800, monitor 4h, then gradual. Watch #eng-runtime for telemetry.

Maya (Docs): Please add any customer-facing copies you want on the shared doc and ping me. Priya, assigning the canned replies ticket to you.
